title: The Last Service
sentences: The night before the city fell, Christians gathered in Hagia Sophia one last time.
It was the evening of May 28, 1453.
Greek and Latin clergy prayed side by side, despite years of bitter division.
Emperor Constantine the Eleventh took communion and asked for forgiveness.
Then he went back to the walls.
In the early hours of May 29, the final Ottoman attack began.
It was the last Christian service in the great church before it became a mosque.
